title: Framedrop.ai e Deeploy vencem iniciativa da Startup Portugal e recebem 20 mil euros
what_it_says: Reports the 2024 winners: Framedrop.ai (Most Promising, 15,000 euros, from Coimbra, AI for videocast and podcast editing) and Deeploy (Best Performing, 5,000 euros, tech recruitment platform); a record 125 startups that year; quotes the CEO of Startup Portugal on more than 800 startups boosted.
